versions.content: When processing a received Container PDU and detecting a header where the payload length exceeds the remaining bytes of the container the processing for this Container PDU shall be stopped and the remaining bytes shall be ignored. Furthermore, IPDUM_E_HEADER shall be reported to DET via Det_ReportRuntimeError.
